title: A fun mask indulgence for not much money
text:
I've gotten two monthly packs so far and I've enjoyed it. I usually wouldn't pay over $2/mask, but the novelty and being introduced to new potential favorites is worth the extra couple bucks for me.

I wish there were a reference listing to what mask was in which pack because sometimes I forget if I haven't written down one that I want to look up.
label: positive
